title: Distance this frame
prompt: The robot drives at speed pixels per second, and the last frame took delta seconds. Return how far it moved during that frame. At 100 pixels per second, a 0.016 s frame moves 1.6 pixels.
starter:
func solve(speed, delta) -> float:
	return speed

tests.name: 250 per second for half a second is 125

hints: Pixels per second times seconds gives pixels.
solution:
func solve(speed, delta) -> float:
	return speed * delta
